behavior: Every TaskService method (listTasks, getTask, createTask, importTasks) logs one structured JSON line per outcome: INFO on success with identifying context (task id/count), WARN for not-found/invalid-input with the offending input and reason, ERROR for unexpected exceptions with the exception and enough context to diagnose without full task titles/bodies. All lines correlate with the request's requestId via MDC.
verification: Exercise each method's success and failure paths (GET /api/tasks; GET /api/tasks/{id} valid id and missing id; POST /api/tasks valid and blank title; POST /api/tasks/import valid array, empty array, array with an invalid element) and confirm one business-level JSON log line per case, correct level (INFO/WARN/ERROR), matching requestId to the access-log line, and enough context (task id / offending input / exception) to diagnose without re-running the request
evidence: Exercised each TaskService method's success/failure paths with distinct X-Request-Id headers: listTasks -> "listTasks success count=0" (INFO); createTask -> "createTask success id=33" (INFO), and the @Valid blank-title 400 case produced no service-level line (validation happens before TaskService, matching the access-log WARN); getTask -> "getTask not found id=999999" (WARN) and "getTask success id=33" (INFO); importTasks -> "importTasks success count=2" (INFO), "importTasks success count=0" for [] (INFO), "importTasks invalid element index=1 reason=blank_title" (WARN). Every line's requestId matched the corresponding RequestLoggingFilter access-log line. Also verified via full ./init.sh run.

behavior: GET /api/tasks gains optional query params category, status (combine with AND, exact-match), sortBy (title|createdAt|category, default createdAt), sortDir (asc|desc, default desc), page (default 0), size (default 20). Response body is {content, totalElements, totalPages, page, size}. Invalid sortBy/sortDir -> 400 with a clear message (no crash); invalid page (negative) or size (<=0) -> 400. Filter combination yielding 0 rows -> 200 with empty content. Filtering/sorting/paging is built with Spring Data JPA Specification/Pageable in TaskService (via a JpaSpecificationExecutor<Task> repository and a TaskSpecifications helper), controller stays thin. category/status/createdAt added to Task entity (nullable, null-safe filtering for pre-existing rows) and CreateTaskRequest/TaskResponse gained optional category/status fields.
verification: Automated: src/test/java/com/example/taskapi/TaskFilteringSortingTest.java — 11 @SpringBootTest/MockMvc cases: defaults with no params, filter by category, filter by status, combined category+status (AND), 0-result filter returns empty content with 200, sortBy=title/sortDir=asc ordering, invalid sortBy -> 400, invalid sortDir -> 400, negative page -> 400, non-positive size -> 400, pagination metadata across multiple pages. Run via './mvnw test'. Manual: curl with category+status combo, sortBy/sortDir, invalid sortBy/sortDir/page, and a zero-result filter against a running instance.
evidence: ./mvnw clean test: TaskFilteringSortingTest 11/11 passed. ./check_architecture.sh: 'Architecture check OK'. ./init.sh passed end-to-end (build, health check, POST/GET smoke checks against the new paginated GET /api/tasks response). Manual curl verification: category=work&status=open returned only matching tasks; sortBy=title&sortDir=asc&size=2 returned correctly ordered page with totalElements/totalPages metadata; sortBy=bogus and sortDir=bogus each returned HTTP 400; page=-1 returned HTTP 400; category=nonexistent returned 200 {"content":[],"totalElements":0,"totalPages":0,"page":0,"size":20}.
